description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget for a checkout screen in a mobile shopping application. It includes UI components such as address and payment method blocks, order summary, and a place order button, with styling and navigation logic.

classes.name: CheckoutScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget representing the checkout screen UI, with components for address, payment, order summary, and order placement.

classes.name: _SectionCard
classes.description: A private widget that represents a tappable section (address or payment method) with icon, title, and subtitle.

classes.name: _SummaryRow
classes.description: A private widget for displaying a label and value, used in the order summary section.

classes.name: _Badge
classes.description: A private widget for displaying a small circular badge with text, used for cart item count.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the UI of the CheckoutScreen widget, including app bar, address/payment sections, summary, and button.
